title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
abstract: This paper introduces residual learning for training substantially deeper visual recognition networks by learning residual functions with shortcut connections.
authors: Kaiming He, Xiangyu Zhang, Shaoqing Ren, Jian Sun

title: Mask R-CNN
abstract: Mask R-CNN extends Faster R-CNN with a parallel branch for predicting object masks and provides a flexible framework for instance-level recognition.
authors: Kaiming He, Georgia Gkioxari, Piotr Dollár, Ross Girshick

title: CornerNet: Detecting Objects as Paired Keypoints
abstract: CornerNet represents an object by its top-left and bottom-right corners, turning object detection into a keypoint estimation problem.

title: Learning to See in the Dark
abstract: The work learns to recover visually pleasing photographs from raw sensor data captured under very low-light conditions.
authors: Chen Chen, Qifeng Chen, Jia Xu, Vladlen Koltun

title: CenterNet: Objects as Points
abstract: CenterNet detects objects as center points and regresses other object properties from those points, providing a compact anchor-free detector.
authors: Xingyi Zhou, Dequan Wang, Philipp Krähenbühl

title: DETR: End-to-End Object Detection with Transformers
abstract: DETR frames object detection as a direct set prediction problem and removes several hand-designed components from conventional detectors.
authors: Nicolas Carion, Francisco Massa, Gabriel Synnaeve, Nicolas Usunier, Alexander Kirillov, Sergey Zagoruyko

title: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
abstract: NeRF represents a continuous scene with a neural radiance field and renders novel views by querying the learned volumetric function.
authors: Ben Mildenhall, Pratul P. Srinivasan, Matthew Tancik, Jonathan T. Barron, Ravi Ramamoorthi, Ren Ng

title: Swin Transformer: Hierarchical Vision Transformer using Shifted Windows
abstract: Swin Transformer builds hierarchical visual representations with shifted-window attention to improve efficiency and support dense prediction tasks.
authors: Ze Liu, Yutong Lin, Yue Cao, Han Hu, Yixuan Wei, Zheng Zhang, Stephen Lin, Baining Guo

title: Emerging Properties in Self-Supervised Vision Transformers
abstract: The study analyzes self-supervised vision transformers and reports useful emergent properties for visual representation learning.
authors: Mathilde Caron, Hugo Touvron, Ishan Misra, Hervé Jégou, Julien Mairal, Piotr Bojanowski, Armand Joulin

title: Masked Autoencoders Are Scalable Vision Learners
abstract: Masked autoencoders learn visual representations by reconstructing missing patches and scaling the masking strategy to large image models.
authors: Kaiming He, Xinlei Chen, Saining Xie, Yanghao Li, Piotr Dollár, Ross Girshick

title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
abstract: Latent diffusion models perform the diffusion process in a compressed latent space and support high-resolution conditional image synthesis.
authors: Robin Rombach, Andreas Blattmann, Dominik Lorenz, Patrick Esser, Björn Ommer

title: Segment Anything
abstract: The Segment Anything project presents a promptable segmentation model and a large-scale dataset intended to generalize across image domains.
authors: Alexander Kirillov, Eric Mintun, Nikhila Ravi, Hanzi Mao, Chloe Rolland, Laura Gustafson, Tete Xia, Shuaiyi Zhang, Song Yong, et al.

title: InternImage: Exploring Large-Scale Vision Foundation Models with Deformable Convolutions
abstract: InternImage studies large-scale vision foundation models built with deformable convolution operators for classification and dense prediction.
authors: Wenhai Wang, Jifeng Dai, Zhe Dong, Xiaoke Li, Zhongwei Ji, etc.

title: DUSt3R: Geometric 3D Vision Made Easy
abstract: DUSt3R predicts pairwise point maps to simplify geometric 3D reconstruction without requiring calibrated camera poses as input.
authors: Sovann En, Natalia Uzbekova, Antonin Vobecky, Philippe Weinzaepfel, Jérôme Revaud

title: Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Grounded Pre-Training for Open-Set Object Detection
abstract: Grounding DINO combines language grounding with a detection transformer to support open-set object detection from category names or referring expressions.
authors: Shilong Liu, Zhaoyang Zeng, Tianhe Ren, Feng Li, Hao Zhang, Jie Yang, Chunyuan Li, Jianwei Yang, Hang Su, Jun Zhu, Lei Zhang
